```python

    assert multiply(10, 25) == 0
    assert multiply(-12, 34) == 8
    assert multiply(-12, -34) == 8
```

```python
def test_multiply():
    assert multiply(2, 3) == 6
    assert multiply(12, 23) == 6
    assert multiply(10, 25) == 0
    assert multiply(0, 99) == 0
```

```python
def multiply(a, b):
```
